name: O Plateau e Praça Alexandre Albuquerque
subtitle: The Plateau is the historic core of Praia, on the plateau where settlement began in 1615.

facts.label: Settlement began
facts.value: 1615, on a plateau near a beach called Santa Maria

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Administrative seat of the country until independence

facts.label: Layout
facts.value: A central square surrounded by churches, courts, town hall, market, banks and hospitals

facts.label: Markets
facts.value: The Plateau is one of the capital's two main markets, with informal vendors around it

parts.text: The Plateau is the historic core of Praia, on the plateau where settlement began in 1615. It was the administrative seat of the country before independence, and neighbourhoods grew around it afterwards.
